snippet.title: Ghostrunner 2 - Official Anniversary Pack Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the latest Ghostrunner 2 trailer to see what to expect from the Ghostrunner 2 anniversary pack, including three sword and hand skins, a motorcycle skin, and more. Ghostrunner 2 Anniversary Pack is available now on PS5 (PlayStation 5), Xbox Series X|S, GOG, Epic Games Store, and Steam.
